name: Impasse
source:
Between fantasy and reality, you are on your long journey home.

Impasse is a visual novel about being torn between the comfortable past and the challenging future. Navigate your dreams, piece together your story, and explore the eternal nowhere of human fantasy. Impasse is a game that warmly invites you to follow into the surrealistic landscape of daydreaming and look for your own dreams that have faded and vanished.

[From [url=https://rinathecowboy.itch.io/impasse]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在幻想与现实之间，你踏上了回家的漫漫长路。

《僵局》是一部关于在舒适的过去和充满挑战的未来之间挣扎的视觉小说。航行你的梦想，拼凑你的故事，探索人类幻想的永恒无处。《Impasse》是一款游戏，热情邀请你进入白日梦的超现实景观，寻找自己已经褪色和消失的梦想。

[来自[url=https://rinathecowboy.itch.io/impasse]Itch.io[/url]]
